<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Aphet Flash](/Feats.aspx?ID=5464) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 72

**Archetype** [Swarmkeeper](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=223)

**Frequency**
once per round

**Prerequisites**
[Swarmkeeper Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5463)

**Requirements**
Your swarm is outside your body.

</column>

---

Your swarm can emit a bright flash, much like aphet beetles, a genus of flash beetles once used by Osirian miners as sources of light. Each creature in its space must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, or be [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure). The swarm then glows with light like a [torch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2760) until it returns to your body
name: Aphet Flash
requirement: Your swarm is outside your body.
